title: Cyclotomic Split-Prime Support Law
phi3_support_law: p | Phi3(q) implies p = 3 or p ≡ 1 (mod 3)
phi6_support_law: p | Phi6(q) implies p = 3 or p ≡ 1 (mod 6)
theorem_summary: Every prime divisor of Phi3(q)=q^2+q+1 is either 3 or congruent to 1 mod 3, and every prime divisor of Phi6(q)=q^2-q+1 is either 3 or congruent to 1 mod 6. The split-prime arithmetic is therefore the native support law of the whole cyclotomic packet, not merely its defect locus.
